_what: C-9 BV2F ARENA (R-C9-356): PLACEHOLDER BODIES for records with no JOIN-1 art. Each is drawn with an existing en-* kit, scaled so its radius = the record's own sim body radius (ge_fold.r_body) over the kit's reference radius (its mapped records' actorRadius x roster_scale / factor, median). Health bar and name label kept; placeholders are marked HERE ONLY, not on screen. 'rows' = records seen in the smoke runs (by record); 'by_type' = the fallback for any other unmapped record, by its JOIN-1 type_id. Read by scripts/arena/arena_mode.gd.
why_no_body: No JOIN-1 pack was ever made for these creature types (join1_index.json unmapped_wave_records), or the record is a boss's summoned OBJECT (crystal, shard, pool, trap) that KC2 also draws as a token; for gryphon01a a kit exists for the type but the stager kept it for the hypporavens only (deliberate, a5dd23b), so it is treated as a placeholder, not a mapping fix.
